record_type: Point-in-time acceptance evidence for one capability
capability: All-bin coordinate spectrum masks and raw-windowed band RMS
queue_scope: Gap 2 only. Gap 1 was accepted separately. Other SC/ENCO gaps remain separate.
reference_handling: Read-only inspection. Independent implementation. No source implementation was copied.

contract.mask_basis: The existing canonical coherent-gain-corrected one-sided peak vector. No recomputation or comparison tolerance.
contract.coordinates: Exact accepted binary64 FFT coordinates; optional explicit linear-frequency or log-frequency interpolation between adjacent finite limits only. Null gaps never bridge. No extrapolation.
contract.comparison: Measured peak > limit fails. Equality passes. margin_peak=limit-peak; excess_peak=max(peak-limit,0). Uncovered bins remain unknown.
contract.scope: All observed bins, including DC, zeros, even Nyquist and odd final bins. Mask profile coverage beyond observed bins is not established.
contract.units: Waveform API A_peak; reusable engine A_peak or V_peak matching the declared signal. No dB, RMS, detector, or compliance conversion.
contract.bands: Named frequency bounds inside physical Nyquist; explicit endpoints. Empty bands return unavailable. Overlapping bands are independent and not additive.
contract.rms_basis: Raw windowed, detrended discrete Parseval RMS without coherent-gain or power-gain correction. Stable scaled weighted phasors retain representable tiny RMS.
contract.precision: Unsupported nonzero SI underflow rejects explicitly. Exact returned peaks reused as limits pass. Advanced JSON reaches backend unchanged for original-lexeme validation.

oracles.rectangular_8_samples_8_hz: x=1+2*cos(2*pi*n/8)+cos(4*pi*n/8); full RMS=sqrt(3.5), band[1,2] RMS=sqrt(2.5); 1Hz peak2A exceeds1.5A by0.5A.
oracles.hann_5_constant_1a: No detrend: corrected DC peak1A; raw DC-only RMS0.4A; all-bin RMS=sqrt(0.3)A. Mean detrend produces zero.
oracles.subnormal_policy: A nonzero raw FFT coefficient with an underflowed zero canonical peak rejects optional analysis rather than passing a zero limit.

adjacent_python.scope: Includes all 20 independent spectrum cases, verified from JUnit names.

independent_final_python.scope: Frozen sources; canonical equality, subnormal rejection, raw Hann Parseval, all-bin coverage and both old response hashes.

compiled_browser.scope: Eight spectrum desktop/mobile cases and two unchanged noisy-gate cases. Includes exact advanced JSON network bodies, CSV/JSON downloads and stale-result invalidation.

main_runtime: Main e41cc8a remains unchanged on port8003; feature verification uses separate port8004.
history: Previous dated evidence remains unchanged. No push is part of this local acceptance.
